resources.string: Let Pamoja run in the background
Your phone can stop Pamoja when it\'s closed. Then your steps sync late and high fives don\'t arrive.
In App info, open Battery usage and turn on Allow auto launch and Allow background activity.
In App info, turn on Autostart, then set Battery saver to No restrictions.
In App info, open Battery and allow high background power use.
In App info, open Battery and choose Unrestricted.
In App info, open Battery, then App launch. Turn off Manage automatically and leave all three switches on.
